answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of the model on language capabilities: perplexity, a metric also utilized by prior works. We conducted tests on the perplexity metric using Wiki-Text and the c4 dataset.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates language modeling capabilities through perplexity and zero-shot task performance, which are foundational to NLG.
